Benchmark evaluated on: English constituency parsing (WSJ portion of Penn Treebank)

hyperparameters: Adam optimizer with β1=0.9, β2=0.98, ε=1e-9
Learning rate schedule with linear warmup for 4000 steps then inverse square root decay
Residual dropout with rate 0.1 for base model (0.3 for Transformer big on English-to-French)
Base model configuration: 6 layers, d_model=512, d_ff=2048, 8 attention heads (d_k=d_v=64)
Batching approximately 25000 source tokens and 25000 target tokens per batch
Training duration: 100,000 steps (12 hours) for base model; 300,000 steps (3.5 days) for big model

statistical_results: Transformer (big) achieves 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German
Transformer (big) achieves 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-French
Base model achieves 27.3 BLEU (English-to-German) and 38.1 BLEU (English-to-French)
Training times reported: 12 hours for base model and 3.5 days for big model on 8 GPUs
For English constituency parsing: F1 score of 91.3 (WSJ only) and 92.7 (semi-supervised)
figure_results: Figure 1 illustrates the Transformer model architecture
Figure 2 depicts Scaled Dot-Product and Multi-Head Attention mechanisms
Table 2 summarizes BLEU scores and training cost metrics
Table 3 details variations in the Transformer architecture and their impact on performance
Table 4 reports English constituency parsing F1 scores

Expected Results: 28.4 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task
41.8 BLEU on the WMT 2014 English-to-French translation task
Base model training completes in 12 hours on 8 GPUs, while the big model trains in 3.5 days on 8 GPUs
English constituency parsing results include an F1 score of 91.3 (WSJ only) and 92.7 (semi-supervised)
Notes: Checkpoint averaging was used: last 5 checkpoints for base models and last 20 for big models
Beam search applied with a beam size of 4 (translation) and 21 (parsing) along with a length penalty
Positional encodings used sinusoidal functions, with experiments showing similar performance to learned embeddings
Sentence pairs were batched by approximate sequence length to achieve roughly 25,000 tokens for source and target each
